What We Do

Our Services

Complete plumbing, drainage, and septic solutions for homes, businesses, and properties across Samar.

Plumbing Services General plumbing work for homes, offices, and industrial sites.
Declogging Services Clear blocked drains and pipes quickly and thoroughly.
Siphoning & Septic Tank Services Professional septic tank siphoning and cleaning using dedicated vacuum trucks.
Repiping Replace old or damaged pipes with durable new lines.
Installation Proper setup of fixtures, lines, and plumbing systems.
Repair & Maintenance Ongoing care to keep plumbing systems running smoothly.
Special Offer

Lusong Service (Extended Care)

A budget-friendly manual cleaning service performed after siphoning to help remove remaining dirt and residue.

Function
Naturally breaks down built-up solid waste and grease at the bottom of your septic tank — especially helpful if it hasn't been cleaned in a while.
Benefit
  • A cleaner septic system
  • Longer intervals before your next siphoning
  • Savings on long term maintenance costs
Pricing
A small add on fee — in exchange for a better, longer lasting septic tank clean.
